description: Set the PENDING stage value (JSON object string) of a rotation job. Rotation-function API (Secret Rotate Process Control): meant to be called by the rotation trigger's function with the job token it receives, not during normal administration.

jobToken.description: Rotation job token (injected into the rotation function's environment; also in ncloud_secret_get_secret_logs)

keyIsolation.description: Which Secret Manager host to call: 'global' (default) for secrets encrypted with a KMS global key (secretmanager.apigw.ntruss.com); 'regional' for secrets encrypted with a KMS region-isolated key (ocapi-kr.ncloud.com/secretmanager — the only option in the JPN region)

value.description: New pending value as a JSON object string

name: ncloud_secret_job_update_pending_stage
